hint: [Hera] Game Feel UI Mode (Beta) is on ??make this feel alive (Game Feel & Juice Bible). Maximum output for minimum input.
--- canvas ---
Canvas-level setup:
  - Stand up the juice infrastructure first: a tween path (DOTween if available) + an audio manager for SFX.
  - Match UI density to the game's focus profile (ECN:DMN): hardcore action ~80:20 = dense always-on HUD + aggressive feedback; balanced RPG 50:50 = combat UI only in combat; healing/casual 30:70 = minimal contextual UI + soft feedback.
  - React to input within 100ms; show at most 7+-2 info items at once; keep the UI footprint <=30% of the screen.
  - Screen transitions (always animated, never abrupt): same-level = slide 0.3s EaseInOut; parent->child = slide-up/scale-in 0.3s EaseOut; child->parent = 0.25s EaseIn; scene = fade 0.5-1.0s.
  - Hit-pause: on high-impact moments freeze the reaction ~30-80ms before it resolves ??impact feels weighty. Use sparingly, and tween UI on unscaled time so it survives the pause.
  - Accessibility is baseline, not optional: text contrast >=4.5:1, touch targets >=44x44pt, reduce-motion + shake/flash intensity-or-off options.

--- image ---
Image/graphic feel:
  - Appear: Scale 0%->100%, EaseOut (or Back for a playful pop), 0.2-0.3s.
  - Reward/acquisition ??scale the ladder to rarity and keep it HONEST (intensity must match actual value):
      Common: default pop + 10ms haptic / Uncommon: green glow + rising melody / Rare: blue glow + particles + 3px 0.1s shake / Epic: purple burst + 5px 0.15s shake / Legendary: golden burst + light streaks + 10px 0.2s shake + fanfare + 100ms haptic.
  - Acquisition flow: item sucked toward the player 0.3s EaseIn with a trail, inventory icon punch 100->120->100% + glow 0.5s, acquisition SFX.
  - On taking a hit/damage: flash to solid white for 1-2 frames + interrupt/restart the current tween + knock ~5-10px + bassy impact SFX ??make the hit undeniable.
  - If interactive: hover 100%->110%, EaseOut 0.15s.

--- text ---
Text feel:
  - Entrance: fade/slide in, EaseOut 0.3s; sequence multiple lines with a 0.03-0.05s stagger.
  - Changing numbers (score/HP/gold): count up rather than snap ??step every 0.05s, total ~0.25s, EaseOut; optional 120%->100% pop; on a streak/combo raise the tick SFX pitch each step (Peggle / Mario-coin) to sell the build-up.
  - Damage popup: 0%->120%->100% over 0.15s, rise 50px across 0.5s, fade out the last 0.2s.
  - Critical: start 150%->100%, yellow/red + outline glow, +10px 0.1s shake, 50ms haptic; offset multiple popups positionally so they never overlap.

--- empty ---
Container/layout feel:
  - Stagger child entrances with a 0.03-0.05s delay each (a slight offset reads far more polished than all-at-once).
  - Animate layout changes (EaseInOut 0.2-0.3s) instead of snapping children into place.

--- button ---
Button feel (state machine Normal-Hover-Press-Release):
  - Hover: scale 100%->110%, EaseOut 0.15s, +5% brightness.
  - Press: ->95%, EaseOut 0.05s (immediate), -10% color.
  - Release: 95%->110%->100% with Back overshoot, 0.2s; play a click SFX (randomize pitch +-5-8% so repeats don't fatigue); 10ms haptic on mobile.
  - Optional idle: breathe 100%<->101% over a 2s loop.
  - Disabled: desaturate ~50%, opacity 60-70%, block interaction.
  - At a choice fork give EACH button its own clean feedback tone (accept and decline alike) ??the sense of control must be symmetric.
  - Mobile: keep the touch target >=44x44pt / 48x48dp; no hover state, so react on Press.
Tweening: DOTween is enabled in Hera Settings ??implement these with DOTween (project standard), e.g. rt.DOScale(1.1f, 0.15f).SetEase(Ease.OutQuad); chain the release with .SetEase(Ease.OutBack); use .SetUpdate(true) so UI keeps animating on unscaled time during a hit-pause.
Deep specs (full tables/sequences/theory): run `game_feel <topic>` ??ecn_dmn_framework, cognitive_load, accessibility_baseline, ui_trends_2026, ui_inventory, ui_number_change, ui_screen_transition, ui_button, ui_microinteractions.
Golden rule ??double down on the screen's purpose: reward / celebration UI earns big, exaggerated juice (bigger = more important); precision or input-heavy UI (forms, drag, text entry, competitive HUD) stays calm and steady so it stays readable. Honest Juice: presentation intensity must match the actual value of what happened. Always gate strong motion behind a reduce-motion / intensity option, and match feedback weight to action weight.
